title: L3 Security Platform Engineer
description:

Our teams design and deliver intelligent, secure, and high-performance digital solutions that help organizations modernize operations, scale their platforms, and succeed in an increasingly digital world.

As part of a dynamic international ecosystem, we bring together forward-thinking engineers, technology specialists, designers, and delivery professionals who transform ideas into scalable, real-world solutions with measurable business impact.  
If you are motivated by challenge, inspired by technology, and ready to grow with a company that truly invests in its people, your journey starts here.

**Why We Need You**

L3 Security Platform Engineer is responsible for advanced security monitoring, incident investigation, threat analysis, and escalation support within the Security Operations Center. The analyst will lead complex investigations, tune detection use cases, support platform health and configuration activities, mentor junior analysts, and coordinate with incident response, infrastructure, and application teams to strengthen the organization’s security monitoring and response capability. title: Lead Civil Engineer (Infrastructure & Utilities)
description:
**About Invicta-Tech**

Invicta-Tech is a digital design and construction advisory firm specialising in BIM and technology-driven delivery for complex projects across KSA and the GCC. We work with contractors, consultants and asset owners to turn models, drawings and point clouds into measurable, client-ready deliverables aligned with ISO 19650, project EIRs and BEPs.

Our work spans BIM production (LOD 200-500), model coordination and clash management, BIM automation and asset handover, across infrastructure & landscape, airports, hospitality, giga projects, industrial and logistics facilities. Our delivery team is based in Hyderabad.

**About the role**

We are hiring an Lead Civil Engineer (Infrastructure & Utilities) / Infrastructure Technical Lead to own technical delivery of landscape and infrastructure works packages on live KSA projects. You will be the technical face of the project to the client. You lead design discussions, take submissions through review and approval, and run the team of BIM modellers and engineers who produce the work.

This is a hands-on leadership role on live projects. You will take over work already in progress in your first week. You need to pick up quickly where a design stands, what the client has commented on, and what is due next.

**What you will do**

*Design and technical ownership*

* Lead the design of infra works: all wet & dry utilities, smart cities integration, ICT/Security, irrigation, storm water, sewer, potable water, FLS, power, telecom, street lighting ducts and networks, and roads, grading and levels.
* Make and defend technical decisions on layouts, levels, routing, sizing and interfaces with buildings and other disciplines.
* Make sure designs meet client requirements, project standards and the applicable KSA authority and utility requirements.

*Client coordination and approvals*

* Be the client's technical point of contact on your packages.
* Lead design review meetings and workshops. Present design intent clearly.
* Prepare and manage design submissions. Take them through client and authority review to approval.
* Track every client comment to close-out: respond, revise, resubmit. Keep a clean comment and revision log.

*Team leadership*

* Lead a team of BIM modellers and infrastructure engineers. Break down the work, set priorities and assign tasks.
* Review drawings and models before anything goes to the client. You own the quality bar.
* Coach the team on design standards, Civil 3D and BIM workflows, and handling client comments.

*Delivery, quality and coordination*

* Own the deliverables schedule for your packages. Hit submission dates.
* Coordinate with architecture, structure and MEP teams to resolve interfaces and clashes.
* Keep drawings, models and design documentation consistent and correctly revised.
* Flag delivery risks to the partners early, each with a proposed fix.

**What we are looking for (must-have)**

* B.E./B.Tech in Civil Engineering. M.E./M.Tech is a plus.
* 10+ years in infrastructure or external works design, with at least 4 years on projects in Saudi Arabia or the wider GCC.
* Strong hands-on AutoCAD Civil 3D (corridors, grading, pipe networks, surfaces) and AutoCAD.
* Working knowledge of Revit and BIM-based delivery.
* A track record of taking external works designs through client and authority approvals in the Gulf.
* Experience leading a team of modellers or engineers on live deliverables, including reviewing their work.
* Clear written and spoken English. You will write comment responses, prepare reports, and any relevant documentation requested from client and lead client meetings.

**Good to have**

* Experience on giga projects or large master plans in GCC.
* Navisworks and clash coordination experience.
* Knowledge of KSA authority and utility standards and submission processes.
* Model-based quantity take-off.
* Familiarity with ISO 19650 and BIM execution plans (BEP, MIDP).

**How you will be measured**

* Submissions on your packages go out on time and complete.
* Client comments close fast, with few repeat comments on the same issue.
* Designs reach approval in fewer revision cycles.
* The team's work passes your review before it reaches the client.

**What we offer**

* Technical ownership of live Saudi projects from day one.
* A small, senior team. Your judgement directly shapes delivery.
* Room to build and lead the infrastructure practice as the firm grows.
* Competitive compensation based on experience in the range of 1,50,000 to 2,50,000 INR per month.

**Location and work mode**

Hyderabad, India. Full-time, on-site with the delivery team.

**How to apply**

Apply through LinkedIn with your CV. In your application, tell us briefly about one infra work package you took through approval in KSA or the GCC: your role, the team size, and what you would do differently.

Pay: ₹150,000.00 - ₹250,000.00 per month

Application Question(s):

* How many years of work experience do you have with Autodesk Civil 3D?\*
* What is your level of proficiency in English?\*
* How many years have you worked on projects in Saudi Arabia or the GCC?
* What is the largest team of modellers/engineers you have led?
* Are you comfortable working on-site in Hyderabad?\*
* Have you personally taken infra works designs through client or authority approval in KSA/GCC?\*

Work Location: In person

title: Bid Manager
description:
**Job Description: Bid Manager – Smart Structures \& SHM Solutions**

**Job Overview**

Smart Structures is the global leader in wireless **Embedded Data Collector (EDC)** solutions used to determine structural integrity, pile capacity, and long\-term asset health in real\-time. Our patented, cutting\-edge IoT technologies are transforming civil infrastructure by embedding smart intelligence directly into concrete structural elements across their entire life cycle.

We are seeking a highly proactive and competent **Bid Manager** with **7–10 years of experience** to own our end\-to\-end proposal and tendering life cycle in India. The ideal candidate will identify, source, and write winning technical and commercial responses to RFPs from government websites like the **GeM Portal**, Central/State public procurement systems, and corporate aggregators.

* **Experience:** 7–10 years in bid management for heavy civil infrastructure, IoT instrumentation, or telemetry systems. Deep experience writing responses for **Structural Health Monitoring (SHM)** or foundation engineering projects is highly preferable.
* **Location:** **Hyderabad, Telangana** (Remote/Work From Home options are available exclusively for exceptionally experienced candidates).
* **Employment Type:** Full\-time
* **Salary:** Commensurate with experience.

**Key Responsibilities**

**1\. Opportunity Sourcing \& Tender Intelligence**

* Proactively track, filter, and identify relevant RFPs, EOIs, and global tenders published on the **GeM Portal**, state\-level e\-procurement boards, and private corporate aggregator networks.
* Target opportunities explicitly aligned with Smart Structures core offerings, including **Structural Health Monitoring (SHM)**, **Embedded IoT Sensors**, **Smart Structures technology**, **Infrastructure Digital Twins**, and automatic **Data Acquisition Systems (DAQ)**.
* Conduct exhaustive compliance matrices and eligibility screening (Technical, Financial, and Legal criteria) to present concrete go/no\-go recommendations to management.

**2\. Proposal Orchestration \& Solution Writing**

* Own the entire proposal creation life cycle from RFP shredding to post\-submission clarification rounds.
* Write detailed, compelling, and bulletproof technical architectures and narratives that highlight our proprietary capabilities, such as the patented wireless SmartPile® Inspector and Embedded Data Collectors (EDC).

**3\. Statutory Compliance \& Stakeholder Relations**

* Ensure 100% adherence to all evaluation parameters specified by government clients, public sector undertakings (PSUs), and corporate contractors.

**Technical \& Domain Expertise**

* Deep understanding of civil infrastructure technology, structural instrumentation, telemetry networks, cloud computing data pipelines, and real\-time sensor processing.
* Thorough familiarity with the operations of Indian public infrastructure segments (e.g., highway bridge expansions, metro lines, rail networks, deep foundation pilings, or mega\-dam constructions).

**Platform \& Regulatory Familiarity**

* Proven, hand\-on mastery of the **GeM Portal** (bidding, reverse auctions, cataloging) and diverse **Central Public Procurement Portals (CPPP)**.
* Familiarity with tender frameworks governing engineering requirements, such as AASHTO or relevant Indian Road Congress (IRC) / Bureau of Indian Standards (BIS) codes.

**Core Competencies \& Soft Skills**

* Exceptional presentation skills and written English literacy, capable of structuring professional executive summaries and complex tech\-specs under rigid deadlines.
* Agile project management mentality to handle multiple parallel bid timelines seamlessly.
* **Education:** Bachelor’s degree in Civil Engineering, Electronics \& Instrumentation Engineering, Information Technology, or a related technical discipline.

title: Technical Manager
description:
**Role:** Technical Manager

**Experience:** 12\-15 years

**Location:** Hyderabad

**Job Summary**

The Technical Manager – IT Support Services will serve as the primary point of accountability for all IT infrastructure support activities. The role demands deep technical expertise in Linux Systems Administration, Networking, VMware, and Windows Server environments, combined with the ability to lead and coordinate a technical support team to ensure seamless day\-to\-day IT operations.**Key Responsibilities:** **Technical Leadership \& Team Management:**

* Assign, track, and review day\-to\-day tasks to team members; conduct follow\-ups on open incidents and pending issues.
* Act as technical escalation point for L1, L2, and L3 support issues raised via ticketing tools (ServiceNow, JIRA, or equivalent).
* Mentor junior engineers and provide technical guidance on server administration, network troubleshooting, and infrastructure management.
* Coordinate with the Inspiredge off\-site support team for parallel remote assistance based on the requirement.
* Should provide weekly status reports in the required format and with required details
* Should have monthly review of progress/status of issues, updates and improvements
* Shall be the owner of Assets of the group companies with monthly update and review of assets records

**Linux Systems Administration**

* Installation, configuration, and administration of RHEL 6/7/8, CentOS, SUSE Linux, Ubuntu on physical and virtual servers.

* Configure and manage Redhat Linux Clusters, node cabling, and IP management.

**VMware \& Virtualization Management**

* Administer VMware ESXi 5\.5, 6\.0, and higher – including installation, configuration, and ongoing maintenance.
* Create and manage VMware clusters for QA, Development, and Production environments; configure High Availability (HA) and Distributed Resource Scheduler (DRS).

* Troubleshoot Windows 7, 8, 10, and Windows Server 2008 R2 platforms for desktop and server\-level issues.
* Deploy and maintain applications on Windows environments; manage software updates and configurations.

**Networking \& Security**

* Deploy and configure Cisco Switches, Routers, Firewalls (ASA 5512\-X, ASA 5520\), and related network equipment.
* Configure and troubleshoot site\-to\-site VPN and AnyConnect VPN solutions.
* Manage Fortigate devices and Cisco devices.

* Perform regular MySQL database backups and restoration as per business requirements and SLAs.
* Manage system\-level backups, cron job scheduling, system logging, and network logging across all servers.

* Prepare and submit regular performance reports, incident summaries, and SLA compliance reports to client stakeholders.
* Maintain accurate documentation of operational procedures, checklists, and configurations per best practices.

* Coordinate with the client’s IT procurement team on roadmap planning, hardware lifecycle, and infrastructure upgrades.
* Manage vendor relationships for network equipment, server hardware, CCTV, and teleconferencing systems.
* Participate in CAB (Change Advisory Board) approvals and manage change deployment across Dev, Test, and Production environments.

**Hardware \& Data Center Management**

* Install and configure HP C3000 \& C7000 blade enclosures; manage ILO (ILO2/ILO3/ILO4\), OA, ILO firmware updates and resets.
* Configure hardware RAID on HP, Dell, and Supermicro blade servers (1U, 2U, 3U, 4U).
* Manage Dell PowerEdge servers (R410, R420, R710\) including iDRAC6 and iDRAC7 remote management.
* Support deployment and maintenance of data center racks, server mounting, cabling, and structured cabling infrastructure.

**Required Skills \& Experience:**

* Primary Expertise: Linux Administration
* RHEL 6/7/8, CentOS, SUSE Linux 11\.2, Ubuntu, Debian – installation, configuration, patching, migration, and cluster management.
* Expertise: VMware \& Virtualization
* VMware ESXi 5\.5/6\.0, vSphere, HA/DRS, snapshots, cloning, templates, VMware Update Manager.
* Working Knowledge: Cloud (AWS)

* Strong Understanding: Networking
* TCP/IP, OSPF, EIGRP, BGP, RIP, VLANs, VTP, site\-to\-site VPN, AnyConnect VPN, Cisco IOS.

The Incident Commander is a senior cybersecurity communications role responsible for leading stakeholder communication, coordination, and reporting during significant security incidents across Cubic. * Lead the coordination of communications and stakeholder engagement during significant cybersecurity incidents, ensuring information is shared clearly, consistently, and at the right level for each audience.
* Partner closely with technical incident responders and security leaders to understand developing events, assess business impact, and translate complex technical issues into clear, actionable updates.
* Prepare and deliver timely status updates, briefings, and situational reports for executives, internal business teams, customers, and other stakeholders throughout the incident lifecycle.
* Coordinate with legal, compliance, privacy, and business leaders to ensure incident communications are appropriate, accurate, and aligned with contractual, regulatory, and organizational requirements.
* Maintain accurate incident records, timelines, decisions, and communication logs so that key actions, updates, and outcomes are well documented during and after an event.
* Support customer and externally facing communication needs when incidents affect services, contractual obligations, or reporting expectations, helping ensure messaging is professional and consistent.
* Help drive incident readiness by maintaining communication templates, stakeholder contact information, notification processes, and other materials needed to support effective response.
* Participate in and help coordinate incident response exercises, simulations, and readiness activities that improve communication effectiveness and strengthen organizational preparedness.
* Contribute to post\-incident reviews, executive summaries, and follow\-up improvement actions by helping capture lessons learned and identify opportunities to enhance future response efforts.
* Provide escalation support and executive\-ready communications during high\-severity or high\-visibility incidents, often under tight timelines and changing conditions.
* Build strong working relationships across cybersecurity, IT, legal, compliance, customer\-facing teams, and business leadership to enable effective collaboration during complex incidents.

**Staff Design****Evaluation****Engineer** – Automotive Networking

Analog Devices International is seeking an experienced Staff Design Evaluation Engineer to join the Automotive Networking team in Hyderabad , India . In this senior technical role, you will lead the definition and execution of evaluation strategies for FPGA prototypes and automotive networking ASICs, from initial platform bring\-up through system\-level validation, characterisation, and release readiness. You will combine hands\-on laboratory expertise with strong software development, test automation, data analysis, and technical leadership skills to deliver robust, repeatable, and high\-quality evaluation solutions.


You will work closely with design, verification, applications, systems, software, and product engineering teams to identify technical risks, resolve complex issues, and ensure that silicon and supporting platforms meet product and system requirements. As a Staff Engineer, you will provide technical direction, mentor engineers, and drive improvements in evaluation methodologies, tools, and laboratory practices.


**Key Responsibilities**


* Define and lead comprehensive evaluation strategies, test plans, coverage goals, methodologies, and release criteria for FPGA prototypes and automotive networking ASICs.
* Translate product, architecture, and system requirements into measurable laboratory tests, including functional, performance, interoperability, robustness, and corner\-case evaluation.
* Architect, develop, bring up, and maintain hardware and software evaluation platforms, test fixtures, reference systems, and supporting infrastructure.
* Develop modular, maintainable test and automation software in C and Python, including instrument control, data acquisition, regression execution, result processing, and report generation.
* Execute and analyse complex silicon and FPGA test cases; debug failures across hardware, firmware, software, interfaces, and system boundaries.
* Perform electrical and functional measurements using oscilloscopes, logic analysers, protocol analysers, signal generators, power supplies, and other laboratory equipment.
* Lead structured root\-cause investigations, clearly document findings, and work with cross\-functional teams to drive issues to resolution.
* Evaluate A utomotive Ethernet T1S and related networking functionality, including link behaviour, data\-path performance, timing, error handling, diagnostics, and interoperability.
* Develop system\-level hardware, embedded software, scripts, user guides, application examples, test procedures, and technical reports that enable internal and external product evaluation.
* Review evaluation results, identify coverage gaps and technical risks, and communicate evidence\-based recommendations to engineering and programme stakeholders.
* Drive continuous improvement in test architecture, automation, data quality, traceability, repeatability, and laboratory efficiency.
* Provide technical leadership and mentoring, lead design and code reviews, and contribute to planning, estimation, and prioritisation activities.
**Required Qualifications and Experience**

* Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Electronic Engineering, Computer Engineering, or a related discipline, or equivalent relevant experience.
* Typically seven or more years of relevant experience in design evaluation, silicon validation, product engineering, systems engineering, or a comparable role.
* Demonstrated experience evaluating FPGA prototypes and performing bench validation or characterisation of ASICs.
* Strong proficiency in C and Python, with experience developing reliable test, automation, or embedded software.
* Strong knowledge of embedded systems, digital hardware, laboratory measurement techniques, and hardware/software integration.
* Proven ability to diagnose complex problems using structured debugging, critical thinking, root\-cause analysis, and evidence\-based decision\-making.
* Experience capturing, processing, interpreting, and presenting technical data, with a strong focus on accuracy, repeatability, and traceability.
* Working knowledge of Ethernet and networking concepts , together with experience using serial interfaces such as SPI, I²C, and UART.
* Excellent written and verbal communication skills, including the ability to produce clear technical reports and present complex findings to varied audiences.
* Demonstrated technical leadership, collaboration, ownership, and the ability to influence outcomes across cross\-functional teams.
**Preferred Qualifications and Experience**

* Experience with automotive Ethernet technologies, including 10BASE\-T1S, single\-pair Ethernet, MAC\-PHY devices, Physical Layer Collision Avoidance, or related in\-vehicle networking solutions.
* Familiarity with automotive networking architectures, zonal systems, software\-defined vehicles, and relevant industry standards.
* Experience with Ethernet protocol analysis, network traffic generation, performance measurement, interoperability testing, or fault injection.
* Experience developing embedded firmware for microcontrollers and integrating host\-side software with evaluation hardware.
* Experience with audio and video interfaces or data paths, including PDM and RGB8\.
* Familiarity with source control, continuous integration, automated regression frameworks, requirements traceability, and issue\-tracking systems.
* Experience mentoring engineers, leading technical reviews, or coordinating evaluation activities across multiple sites or disciplines.

Novartis architecture principles call for AI adoption guided by business value: AI is evaluated for new solutions and enhancements wherever it delivers a clear benefit, and it must be delivered on infrastructure that is secure, compliant and economically sustainable. It establishes the standard intake pattern by which an AI use case moves from idea to a hosted, monitored, auditable service, so that scientists and business teams get speed without the organisation inheriting uncontrolled risk.

At AMD, we believe technology has the power to solve the world’s most important challenges. From advancing healthcare and scientific discovery to powering AI and the technologies people rely on every day, innovation at AMD is shaping the future.

Responsibilities:

Senior Network Engineer – GPU Cluster Networking **THE ROLE:**  

We are seeking a Senior Network Engineer to join the AMD IT System Engineering team.
This role is responsible for the architecture, deployment, optimization, automation, and production operation of high\-performance backend networks supporting large\-scale AMD GPU clusters. The engineer will own the network path from the GPU server and NIC through the data center switching fabric, ensuring that distributed AI training, large language model, inference, and HPC workloads receive predictable bandwidth, low latency, and reliable collective communication performance.
The ideal candidate will have experience designing, scaling, and operating backend network infrastructure for GPU clusters with approximately 10,000 or more GPUs, or comparable hyperscale AI and HPC environments.
The primary focus of this position is high\-speed Ethernet and RoCEv2 networking for AMD Instinct accelerator clusters. You will work across switches, NICs, optics, RDMA, Linux networking, PCIe and NUMA topology, ROCm, RCCL, SLURM, Kubernetes, storage networks, automation platforms, and observability systems.
You will partner with AMD AI engineering, network engineering, data center, storage, security, platform, and application teams to ensure the backend network fabric is not a bottleneck to GPU workload performance.**THE PERSON:**
You are a highly experienced, hands\-on network engineer with deep expertise in data center networking, RDMA, RoCEv2, and large\-scale GPU cluster fabrics with approximately 10,000 or more GPUs,.
You understand how distributed GPU workloads generate traffic across the backend network and how application performance is affected by network topology, congestion, GPU\-to\-NIC locality, routing, switch buffering, traffic\-class configuration, and collective communication patterns. You take responsibility for end\-to\-end outcomes, including architecture, implementation, qualification, production deployment, monitoring, incident response, capacity planning, and continuous improvement. You use telemetry and repeatable performance testing to validate designs and make data\-driven engineering decisions.
You are comfortable leading complex technical initiatives, mentoring engineers, documenting architecture and operating standards, and working across globally distributed organizations.**KEY RESPONSIBILITIES**:* Architect, deploy, operate, and continuously improve high\-performance backend networks for large\-scale AMD Instinct GPU clusters.
* Design network fabrics capable of supporting AI and HPC environments ranging from individual GPU racks to clusters containing 10,000 or more GPUs.
* Own the backend network architecture from the GPU server and network interface card through the leaf\-spine switching fabric.
* Design and optimize high\-speed Ethernet fabrics using RoCEv2 and 100/200/400 GbE technologies.
* Develop scalable network topologies, including leaf\-spine, Clos, fat\-tree, rail\-optimized, multi\-plane, and non\-blocking fabric architectures.
* Perform network topology modeling, oversubscription analysis, traffic\-flow analysis, bandwidth planning, port\-capacity planning, failure\-domain analysis, and long\-term growth forecasting.
